title: Connector/ODBC SQLGetDescRec treats descriptor handle as statement handle, heap OOB write on every call
vulnerabilityInformation: A heap buffer overflow vulnerability was discovered in the ODBC driver's SQLGetDescRec and SQLGetDescRecW functions. These functions incorrectly used a statement handle macro on a descriptor handle, causing writes 13 bytes past the end of a 720-byte descriptor allocation. On standard builds, this memory corruption was sufficient to trigger heap consistency checks and crash the process. Additionally, a portion of the buffer was filled with server-supplied version information, which allowed a network attacker to influence the offset of a secondary write operation. The vulnerability affected the current master branch of the driver and was confirmed to cause crashes and memory corruption.
